includes: Complete spatial field persistence and copy isolation
Front-coat proxy depth and accessory hit guards

limits: Relative editing of the original Gaussian asset, not reconstruction of individual fibers or physical strand simulation
Added curl at zero preserves the asset's existing curl; it does not straighten original baked curls
Fur weights use original color and spatial ranges; brush hits use measured ellipsoid proxies rather than exact surface geometry
Accessory protection is approximate, with boundary blending; new views and additional accessories need further validation
Real-time geometry changes keep existing view-dependent color rather than physically relighting each fiber
This QA covers the current Windows desktop browser, not mobile-device performance
